_note: Wave 5.2 /. The hash is SHA-256 over `<buildId>|<sorted-name>,...,|` (names + buildId only). `sourceCommit` is informational SLSA-style provenance — the artifact signature makes it trustworthy; auditors `git diff` a fork against the §4.1 protection-file list. We deliberately do NOT hash class-file bytecode (see §4.1 'Decision (2026-05-29)'): bytecode is compiler/JDK-dependent and the artifact signature already covers integrity. Re-generate the hash via the PrintCanonicalMoralDefaultsHash test when ProtectionManifest.canonicalDefaults() changes; bump sourceCommit when re-stamping. 2026-07-21: `resilience_corpus` REMOVED from the attested set — the corpus was never generated (V9 trained on vitality/drive tags only), so the attestation vouched for a nonexistent artifact; it returns when the corpus ships (post-OSS roadmap).
